title: IVG Intense Salts Vanilla Biscuit 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Vanilla Biscuit recreates the comforting taste of a classic Biscuit sandwiched with smooth Vanilla custard. The flavour combines a buttery, crumbly base with a sweet, creamy centre for a profile that’s warm and indulgent. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid provides clear flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Vanilla Biscuit is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits, pens and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Vanilla Biscuit is a dessert-inspired option for vapers who enjoy bakery-style blends.
